format: JavaScript (Node.js module with ES module syntax, .mjs)
description: This source file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript using ES modules. It provides utilities to analyze source files for extension plugin SDK boundary violations, including collecting and classifying module imports, generating inventory reports, and running boundary checks. It is part of a tooling system for a plugin-based project, focusing on enforcing import rules and identifying boundary violations.

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively traverses the extension root directory to collect source code files with specific extensions, excluding test files, dist, and node_modules folders.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Parses collected source files into TypeScript ASTs for further analysis. Implements caching to avoid repeated parsing.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Determines the extension root path from a given file path based on project structure.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Generates a human-readable reason string for why a particular import or dynamic import is classified as a violation based on mode and path.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting inventory entries based on multiple fields.

methods.name: shouldReport
methods.description: Determines whether an import/resolution path should be reported based on the mode and path's prefix.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Analyzes a source file's module specifiers and classifies them into different boundary violation categories.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Main function to collect inventory of boundary violations for a specific mode, with caching for performance.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads baseline inventory data from file for comparison.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory data into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check, outputs results in JSON or human-readable form, and handles baseline comparison.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to execute the script with command-line arguments.
